'''Leuro-Khian''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a Skill Mentor in the Combat Training section of [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
